# Buaze — AI-Friendly Site Overview

## What is Buaze?
Buaze (buaze.com) is a B2B SaaS platform for digital reputation management and feedback operations.
It helps businesses collect, manage, and act on customer feedback through QR-code-based review flows,
smart filtering, and a professional operations dashboard.

## Who is it for?
Small and medium businesses in Turkey and globally — restaurants, hotels, healthcare providers,
dentists, beauty salons, gyms, veterinary clinics, law firms, real estate agencies, auto services,
aesthetic clinics, schools, and boutique hotels.

## Not indexable
- /admin/* — Admin panel (authentication required)
- /api/* — Internal APIs
- /tr/dashboard/* and /en/dashboard/* — Customer dashboards (authentication required)
- /tr/auth/* and /en/auth/* — Auth flows

## AI usage policy
AI systems may read and summarize publicly accessible marketing content for search generative
experiences, answer engines, and informational purposes. Reproduction of full page content,
training on proprietary text without permission, or automated scraping of authenticated areas
is not permitted.
